text:
alyssa: Quick sync 3055 5 iterating on the model catalog compare view. Two ideas: A) sticky compact 'comparison summary' row when 2+ models are checked (shows aggregated perf + est cost), or B) compress active filters into a single 'Filters' chip that expands into a flyout. Mock attached. Thoughts? seon (Design): I'm leaning to the sticky summary for discoverability. Concern: eats vertical space on smaller screens. Maybe default to collapsed and expand on hover/focus. :thinking: mike_s (Eng): Technically ok. Sticky outside virtual list is required. Slight perf hit but acceptable. I can make a prototype if we lock design. jamie (Product): Badge copy: favor concise labels to prevent wrapping: 'Latency (p50)', 'Cost / 1k', 'Error %'. 1-2 words recommended. ravi (Eng-ML): Suggest adding 'KV cache hit' as a micro-metric for comparison. Often differentiates infra cost. luz (A11y): A11y checklist: sticky summary must be keyboard-focusable and programmatically announced. Filters chip needs aria-expanded with an accessible flyout dialog. seon (Design): Example markup: ```html
...
``` mike_s (Eng): For badges, don't rely on color alone. Add icon + text, and include visually-hidden descriptions for screen readers (e.g., 'Low latency'). jamie (Product): Empty state copy for flyout: 'No filters applied — try "model size" or "latency" to narrow results.' Keep it actionable. alyssa: Where should 'version lock' live — toolbar bulk action or per-row? ravi (Eng-ML): Both. Toolbar for multi-locks, per-row for single. Implementation straightforward. seon (Design): I've updated the mock with a compact toolbar 'Lock versions' button and a small per-row lock icon. Preview posted. :sparkles: luz (A11y): Confirm flow: 'Lock versions' triggers a confirm dialog. Announce status updates via role=status (e.g., 'Versions locked for 3 models'). Ensure lock icon has aria-label. aria-bot: Accessibility scan complete — mock flagged low contrast on lock tooltip text for small sizes. Recommend 4.5:1 for small text. Report: https://mock.report/scan/xyz mike_s (Eng): I'll do a micro-prototype and link a PR. ETA Friday EOD. Please sign off on copy + A11y beforehand. jamie (Product): I can sign off after badges are switched to icon+color and the flyout copy updated. alyssa: I'll update the mock with those changes and post final assets. If no objections by Monday, I'll ask Eng to implement. :thumbsup:
